    # {u2, u3} -> u1 | u2*u3
    if (U[0]*U[1]) % U[2] != 0: return False
    if (U[0]*U[2]) % U[1] != 0: return False
    if (U[1]*U[2]) % U[0] != 0: return False
    return True
